findings.detail: Missing HSTS header. Site is vulnerable to protocol downgrade attacks.
Missing CSP header. Site is vulnerable to XSS and data injection attacks.
findings.remediation: Implement a Content Security Policy restricting resource loading.

findings.detail: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header. Browser may MIME-sniff responses.
Missing X-Frame-Options header. Site may be vulnerable to clickjacking.
Missing Permissions-Policy header. Browser features are unrestricted.
findings.remediation: Add a Permissions-Policy header restricting access to browser features.

findings.detail: Missing Referrer-Policy header. Sensitive URL data may leak to third parties.
Server reflects arbitrary origin in CORS header. Credentials allowed — attacker can make authenticated cross-origin requests.
findings.remediation: Validate Origin header against a strict server-side allowlist. Never reflect arbitrary origins.
